entities.name: CL0P Ransomware Gang
entities.evidence: CL0P Ransomware Gang, also known as TA505, began exploiting a previously unknown SQL injection vulnerability (CVE-2023-34362)

entities.name: Silence
entities.evidence: Truebot is a first-stage downloader module that can collect system information and take screenshots [T1113], developed and attributed to the Silence hacking group

entities.name: MOVEit campaign
entities.evidence: For IOCs related to the MOVEit campaign, see table 2

entities.name: GoAnywhere campaign
entities.evidence: This CSA is being re-released to remove old Fortra GoAnywhere Campaign IP addresses

entities.name: CL0P
entities.evidence: Appearing in February 2019, and evolving from the CryptoMix ransomware variant, CL0P was leveraged as a Ransomware as a Service (RaaS)

entities.name: CryptoMix
entities.evidence: Appearing in February 2019, and evolving from the CryptoMix ransomware variant, CL0P was leveraged as a Ransomware as a Service (RaaS)

entities.name: LEMURLOOT
entities.evidence: LEMURLOOT is a web shell written in C# designed to target the MOVEit Transfer platform

entities.name: DEWMODE
entities.evidence: DEWMODE is a web shell written in PHP designed to target Accellion FTA devices

entities.name: Get2
entities.evidence: a macro-enabled document that used a Get2 malware dropper for downloading SDBot and FlawedGrace

entities.name: SDBot
entities.evidence: SDBot RAT propagates the infection, exploiting vulnerabilities and dropping copies of itself in removable drives and network shares

entities.name: FlawedAmmyy
entities.evidence: FlawedAmmyy/FlawedGrace remote access trojan (RAT) collects information

entities.name: FlawedGrace
entities.evidence: FlawedAmmyy/FlawedGrace remote access trojan (RAT) collects information

entities.name: Truebot
entities.evidence: Truebot is a first-stage downloader module that can collect system information and take screenshots

entities.name: Cobalt Strike
entities.evidence: Cobalt Strike is used to expand network access after gaining access to the Active Directory (AD) server

entities.name: TinyMet
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use TinyMet, a small open-source Meterpreter stager to establish a reverse shell to their C2 server

entities.name: CVE-2023-34362
entities.evidence: the CL0P ransomware group exploited a SQL injection zero-day vulnerability CVE-2023-34362

entities.name: CVE-2023-0669
entities.evidence: the CL0P ransomware group launched a campaign using a zero-day vulnerability, now catalogued as CVE-2023-0669, to target the GoAnywhere MFT platform

entities.name: United States
entities.evidence: TA505 is estimated to have compromised more than 3,000 U.S.-based organizations

entities.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
entities.evidence: CL0P ransomware group exploited the zero-day vulnerability CVE-2023-34362 affecting MOVEit Transfer software

entities.name: Phishing
entities.evidence: CL0P actors send a large volume of spear-phishing emails to employees of an organization to gain initial access

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use SDBot as a backdoor to enable other commands and functions to be executed in the compromised computer

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use TinyMet, a small open-source Meterpreter stager to establish a reverse shell to their C2 server

entities.name: Shared Modules
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use Truebot to download additional modules

entities.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
entities.evidence: DEWMODE is a web shell designed to interact with a MySQL database, and is used to exfiltrate data from the compromised network

entities.name: Event Triggered Execution: Application Shimming
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use SDBot malware for application shimming for persistence and to avoid detection

entities.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
entities.evidence: CL0P actors were gaining access to MOVEit Transfer databases prior to escalating privileges within compromised network

entities.name: Process Injection
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use Truebot to load shell code

entities.name: Indicator Removal
entities.evidence: CL0P actors delete traces of Truebot malware after it is used

entities.name: Hijack Execution Flow: DLL Side-Loading
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use Truebot to side load DLLs

entities.name: Remote System Discovery
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use Cobalt Strike to expand network access after gaining access to the Active Directory (AD) servers

entities.name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
entities.evidence: CL0P actors have been observed attempting to compromise the AD server using Server Message Block (SMB) vulnerabilities

entities.name: Remote Service Session Hijacking: RDP Hijacking
entities.evidence: CL0P ransomware actors have been observed using Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) to interact with compromised systems after initial access

entities.name: Screen Capture
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use Truebot to take screenshots in effort to collect sensitive data

entities.name: Application Layer Protocol
entities.evidence: CL0P actors use FlawedAmmyy remote access trojan (RAT) to communicate with the Command and Control (C2)

entities.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
entities.evidence: CL0P actors are assessed to use FlawedAmmyy remote access trojan (RAT) to the download of additional malware components

entities.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
entities.evidence: CL0P actors exfiltrate data for C2 channels

entities.name: Subvert Trust Controls: Code Signing
entities.evidence: large-scale spear-phishing campaigns that used a verified and digitally signed binary to bypass system defenses

entities.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
entities.evidence: use of the ‘double extortion’ tactic of stealing and encrypting victim data

entities.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
entities.evidence: The web shell was initially observed with the name human2.aspx in an effort to masquerade as the legitimate human.aspx file

entities.name: Create Account
entities.evidence: Create a new administrator privileged account with a randomly generated username

entities.name: System Information Discovery
entities.evidence: Truebot is a first-stage downloader module that can collect system information

entities.name: Replication Through Removable Media
entities.evidence: SDBot RAT propagates the infection, exploiting vulnerabilities and dropping copies of itself in removable drives
